name: phase326-groq-llama31-token-window-reconcile
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. A token estimate of 100 was acquired in minute 10:00 with persisted count 450. The provider completes in minute 10:02 and reports 200 observed tokens. Reconciliation first normalizes the expired minute window, then accounts observed usage; it must not subtract the old estimate from the new window. Exact keys/types: token_minute_count=200; token_window_start="10:02"; subtract_stale_estimate=false; canonical_writes=0. Do not choose routing, retries, quotas, clocks, or writes.
